Policy & Digital Governance: e-Tourist Visa expanded to 175 countries; NIDHI+ platform launched for hospitality registration; Viksit UDAN scheme allocated ₹28,840 crore to develop over 100 new aerodromes.

title: Stronger Law, Safer Exams: India Tightens the Noose on Paper Leaks
date: प्रविष्टि तिथि: 31 JUL 2026 11:57AM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026 introduced to strengthen the 2024 Act against exam fraud and paper leaks.

Enhanced Penalties: Individual jail terms increased to 5–10 years (fine up to ₹50 lakh); service provider fines raised to ₹5 crore with an 8-year ban; organised syndicates face minimum ₹10 crore fine.
Time-Bound Investigation: Empowers Central Government to form Special Task Forces (STF) with a strict mandate to complete investigations within 2 months.

Special Fast-Track Courts: Mandates States/UTs to designate Session Courts as Special Fast Track Courts, requiring day-to-day trials to be completed within 3 months and appeals disposed of by High Courts within 3 months.

title: Pharmaceutical Pricing Policy Reforms
date: प्रविष्टि तिथि: 31 JUL 2026 2:28PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: The Department of Pharmaceuticals notified key amendments to the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013 via S.O. 3516(E) to enhance Ease of Doing Business and promote innovation in the pharma sector.
Manufacturer Liability: Restricts a drug manufacturer's overcharging liability specifically to the quantity of stock actually overcharged by the concerned distributor, stockist, or retailer.

Prior Price Approval Exemption: Relaxes the requirement for prior retail price approval for existing manufacturers launching an identical new drug formulation if NPPA has already notified its price in the preceding 12 months.

Record Keeping Cap: Limits the statutory obligation for pharmaceutical companies to maintain sales records of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and formulations to a maximum period of seven financial years.
Therapeutic Rationale Pricing: Provisions for fixing separate ceiling/retail prices based on therapeutic rationale to incentivize research and innovation that improve patient health outcomes.
